description: Turn an app's release kit (a JSON manifest with screenshots before and after, short screen recordings, changelog lines, brand colours, font and logo: docs/product-kit.md) into a product video on this computer, and queue it to render. Presets: appstore-iphone (886x1920), appstore-iphone-55 (1080x1920), appstore-ipad (1200x1600): App Store app previews, 15-30 s, 30 fps, H.264, the app full screen with captions (App Review Guideline 2.3.4); play-promo (1920x1080, for the YouTube link Google Play takes); social-9x16 and social-1x1 (drawn devices, a before -> after reveal, an end card). The kit is downloaded first (https only, size-capped, every file checked; nothing in it is run); a kit of the same name and its earlier renders are replaced. Returns the video id: follow it with job_status slug=<id>; when it is done its result holds the file path and a /api/product/file link. Uses no AI and posts nothing; ai_estimate and ai_review take the id to review the result inside the AI limits.

encoding.description: Optional encoding for this render; every field is optional and anything left out keeps the preset's store-compliant default (the App Store presets: constrained CBR at 11 Mbps, 30 fps, AAC 256 kbps at 48 kHz). rateControl cbr = one held rate (target = min = max, still screens padded so the rate never drops); vbr = a target with a ceiling and an optional floor (minKbps: a file under it is encoded again as CBR at the floor); crf = a quality (0-51, lower is better) with an optional ceiling.

audioBed.description: The sound under the picture: {kind: "dither"} (a quiet bed, the default) or {kind: "music", id: "<a music file in the studio's audio library>", volume: 0-1}.

id.description: A music file's name in the audio library (Reels > Audio).

audioKbps.description: AAC bit rate in kbps (App Store: 256; YouTube recommends 384).

bufsizeKbits.description: VBV buffer in kbit (App Store: at most 31250).

maxKbps.description: Ceiling in kbps (vbr, crf); under cbr it is the target. Inside the H.264 level (App Store: level 4.0, at most 25000).

minKbps.description: Floor in kbps (vbr, crf); under cbr it is the target.

videoKbps.description: Target video bit rate in kbps (cbr, vbr).

kitUrl.description: The release kit's manifest: an https:// link (a release kit's signed link) or file:///path/to/kit/manifest.json on this computer.

name.description: A name for the kit, e.g. "my-app-1-4" (lowercase, digits, single dashes). Leave out for the app's name and version.

preset.description: One of: appstore-iphone, appstore-iphone-55, appstore-ipad, play-promo, social-9x16, social-1x1.

name: make_product_video
title: Make a product video from a release kit
